title: Runtime Player Control Channel intent.envelope payload (C5 §2)
description: C5 payload for the intent.envelope kind (ADDED ADDITIVELY over intent.set). slotId rides the same semantic-slot vocabulary; peak is the slot's normalized target value; attackMs/sustainMs/decayMs are the非負 curve durations the 器 draws at 60Hz (attack: current→peak, sustain: hold peak, decay: peak→rest). Release is the universal non-exposed default, so it is NOT on the wire. NOTE: this 'envelope' is the animation envelope, a different concept from the C4 message 封筒 (channel-envelope-schema.json).

slotId.description: Semantic-slot id (existing vocabulary). An unknown id is rejected with unknownSlot.

peak.description: Normalized peak value the curve rises to. Centered slots (head/gaze/body) accept -1..1; weight slots (blink/mouth-open/mouth-smile) and vowel slots accept 0..1. Out of range is rejected with slotValueOutOfRange (never clamped).

attackMs.description: Rise time (current effective value → peak) in milliseconds. Negative is rejected with invalidPayload.

sustainMs.description: Hold time at peak in milliseconds. Negative is rejected with invalidPayload.

decayMs.description: Fall time (peak → rest) in milliseconds. Negative is rejected with invalidPayload. attackMs + sustainMs + decayMs must be > 0 (a zero-life envelope is rejected with invalidPayload).
